cover_letter_text:
Hi J&P Building Solutions team,

I'm Marc, and I'd like to apply for your Graduate Civil/Structural Engineer role. Learning from an experienced team on design-led residential and commercial builds is what I'm looking for. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and in February 2026 I graduated with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design.

On a community hall renovation in the Philippines in 2019, I reviewed the structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them. I also coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day and kept the client up to date. I've modelled a pedestrian truss bridge in 3D in Revit, and a footing and column in AutoCAD.

I'm in Melton with my own car, I can start two weeks after an offer, and I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Thanks for your time, and I'm happy to chat.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
